warnings.message: Codex plugins can't add to AGENTS.md, so that part of @examples/house-style was left out.
Codex plugins carry no agents, so that part of @examples/code-reviewer was left out.
@examples/format-on-edit's command uses an $RMK_ variable; Codex passes the event as JSON on stdin instead, so the hook has to read it from there.
Codex's tool names aren't documented, so @examples/format-on-edit runs for every tool instead of only `edit`; it can check the tool in the event it reads on stdin.
Skills don't take arguments, so @examples/review-diff's placeholders stay in its text, with a note saying what each one is.
Codex plugins can't set permission rules, so that part of @examples/safe-git was left out.
